headline: Your AI says everything looks fine. Every week.
body: That is almost never agreeableness. It is that you gave it targets instead of floors, so nothing can be off track.

headline: A prompt is what you ask. A charter is who it is.
body: The line that does the work: name something the seat will refuse, even when it would rather not.

headline: Scheduled work dies without telling you.
body: A job that stops does not error. It produces nothing, and nothing looks exactly like a quiet week. Mine went 40 days.

headline: A plausible number looks exactly like a real one.
body: One line fixes it: if a number you need is missing, say it is missing. Do not estimate it.

headline: Autonomy is a ladder, not a switch.
body: The seat requests, citing its own decision log. You grant or hold. Promotions are revocable.
